name: V935 Sco

paper.title: Planet-forming disks and their environment across regions and time from the full NIR census

notes: First-published SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (DESTINYS). Both disk and ambient contribution are detected: an inclined disk (P.A. 80 deg, extent ~50 au) with visible back side, plus asymmetric diffuse ambient scattered light out to 150 au. Disk features: back side; ambient features: ambient interaction (Garufi et al. 2026, Table A.5/Fig. A.1).
